name: duopore-public-client-report
description: Show a client what changed between two sets of numbers, with a report you can check.

interface.longDescription: Show a client what changed between two sets of numbers, with a report you can check. Share last period's figures and this period's figures. See the change for each measure, in numbers and percent where it can be worked out. Add your own notes. Get PDF and Excel files in a supported host or on the website. The app does not guess why results changed.
defaultPrompt: Compare these two weekly reports and show what changed.
Make a client report from these figures without guessing the cause.
